title: Ava's Cosmic Robot Party
introLine: Welcome aboard the Starship Sparkle, Ava! Our robot friends are getting ready for a big space dance.
closingLine: Now, let's help the robots line up for their big dance move!

scenes.title: The Robot Workshop
scenes.narration: Look at these shiny robots! Ava, can you help them find partners? When every robot has a buddy, they make an even team. If one is left out, it is odd. Let's count them together in their neat rows.
scenes.imagePrompt: A bright, friendly spaceship workshop with colorful robots standing in two straight rows. Polished 2D children educational game art, soft lighting, no text.

scenes.title: Equal Group Launchpad
scenes.narration: Time to load the glitter-fuel! We need to put the same number of batteries into each robot's power pack. When groups are equal, the robots can fly straight. Are these groups the same? Let's compare and count each one to be sure!
scenes.imagePrompt: Friendly robots holding glowing purple batteries on a starry launchpad. Two clear groups of robots, vibrant space background. Polished 2D children educational game art, no text.
